tasks.label: Bank: regenerate from the guide's ZIM
tasks.detail: Runs bank/build.py all in python:3.12-slim against the airplanemode_guide-data volume
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v airplanemode_guide-data:/data:ro -v "${workspaceFolder}:/src" -w /src python:3.12-slim sh -c "pip install -q libzim==4.1.0 lxml==6.1.3 && python bank/build.py all /data/zim/wikivoyage_en_all_nopic_2026-09.zim"
